pages: Y-you can really do that, kekeh?
Of course... But there is a price...
Wh-what is it, keh? My family's heirloom bones?
Your... toward me...
...absolute loyalty.
Loyalty?
Cheap at the price, keh! So you're my new boss, keh?
(Talk is cheap, keh.) So, what do I have to do, keh?
Souls.
More souls... sent to me in the demon realm...
So that I may remain myself...
Send me strong souls as sacrifices.
Kekeke! In other words, keh!
I just need to drag more warriors than ever down into darkness, keh?
Easy as pie, keh! Just what I wanted, keh!
Then the pact is sealed...
Gen'an... offer me more souls...
Nkekeke! Rejoice, Azami!
Nkekeke! Azami, I'm back, keh!
D-dear! You're safe... you're really safe...
Yay! He's back! Papa, Papa!
Sorry I worried you, keh...
Gen'an, destroyed by his own arrogance,
thus returned from the demon realm.
Crueler and more savage than ever before,
Gen'an was reborn.
Gen'an marches on,
straight down the path of darkness he believes in...
Kekeke... Now then, who shall I drag into darkness next, keh...
The one true king of darkness is...
None other than Shiranui Gen'an, keh!
What the hell, what the hell!
You want us to pay money for this lousy food?
Hey, old man!
Th-that's terrible! You're customers, yes?
Burp... Man, that was awful.
We oughta get a medal just for eating every last bite!
Seriously, we should be the ones sending YOU a bill!
You can't do this, customers!
You ordered plate after plate and gobbled it all up happily...
You can't say that, you see!
You idiot! Can't you tell we were being nice?
If we ate lookin' disgusted, we'd hurt your feelings!
We kept orderin' plate after plate
outta pity, hopin' something edible would show up!
And you let us down anyway...
B-but... that's 20 servings, eaten for free, yes?
Hey, don't make it sound so bad!
Hey, hey! This ain't a show! Beat it!
See ya, old man! Work on your cooking a little, huh?
W-wait, you!
Eating without paying, then insulting my cooking too...
Lou, best chef in Peking, can't take this, you see!
Hey, old man, what're you doin'?!
Heh heh heh... You're gonna pay for this.
Hey, old man!
Don't you know who we are?!
We're the one and only Earthquake Gang!
Eeeeeek!
Ah! It's the Wan-Fu dojo!
It's Lord Wan-Fu's students!
Stop this, in the middle of the street!
The Wan-Fu dojo won't allow such violence in Peking!
What's this... some weirdos showed up.
Got a problem with us?! Huh?!
I'm all right, you see...
Those men ate at the Peking Restaurant without paying!
Unforgivable, yes!
You there! Apologize and pay up now, and we'll let it go!
Heh! If you want the money, take it by force!
Ow, ouch! Ow ow ow...
Eek, eeek... M-mercy, have mercy!
Learned your lesson?! Now leave the money and go!
D-damn it...
You'll pay for this! Ow ow ow...
There, Lou... What a terrible ordeal for you...
Ah, you saved me, yes...
Just what I'd expect from Lord Wan-Fu's students!
No... Lord Wan-Fu left the dojo in our unworthy hands
and set off on a journey.
We are only following Lord Wan-Fu's orders.
Lord Wan-Fu's students are truly something, you see!
Lord Wan-Fu is a friend to us common folk, yes!
Long live Lord Wan-Fu!
Long live the Wan-Fu dojo!
What's all this commotion before Tiananmen?
Ohh... It's Lord Wan-Long, you see!
Lord Wan-Long has returned to Peking!
Ah... Wan-Fu's men... What happened here?
Some ruffians were causing trouble,
so we taught them a lesson in Lord Wan-Fu's place.
I see... Good work, then.
However, report such matters to the authorities first.
Even a just fight, without proper channels, is mere brawling.
Since it is you, I will overlook it this time...
...Yes, sir.
Come on, come on! Clear the way!
Lord Wan-Long returns in triumph from crushing a rebellion!
He is in a hurry!
Lord Wan-Long has another victory, yes?
Every time he goes to war he comes back a hero, you see...
Lord Wan-Fu still hasn't come back...
Is it because he doesn't get along with Lord Wan-Long?
No, no.
Lord Wan-Fu wouldn't leave the capital over that, you see...
I hear he's gone on a journey to find a true man.
A true man, you say...
This is the place, boss!
Damn it! We'll pay you back for the other day!
Heh heh heh, so this is that dojo-whatever, huh?
Hey! The Earth Gang, feared by all, is here to return the favor!
Don't you ignore us!
Come out quick, or we'll torch your precious dojo!
I'm so hungry...
Boooss... I wanted to eat for free too...
Heh heh heh, Kinzo... just hang on a little longer...
We'll get a little pocket money from these guys,
and then you can eat your fill... Heh!
Yaaay! That's our boss!
Then let's hurry up and smash 'em!
Come on! Where'd all that attitude from last time go?!
...Aaaagh!
Well, if it isn't those freeloaders from before!
Looks like the beating we gave you wasn't enough...
This time, you're the ones learnin' a lesson!
Get 'em!
How's that?! Taste the fists of the Wan-Fu style!
Now, villains, get out of Peking!
D-damn it! B-boss!
Heh heh heh heh... Can't be helped...
So you're the ringleader of these crooks!
We'll punish you in Lord Wan-Fu's stead!
Well now, guess I'll play with ya a bit... Heh.
Hyah!
Ngh... What is this guy?!
What, that's it?
All right, now it's my turn!
Heh heh heh, too easy, too easy!
All right, boys, have at 'em!
Heh heh heh... That's our boss!
Cross the Earth Family and see what happens!
We'll teach ya with our fists!
Stop this at once!
M-my lady...
Whoa there...
Now ain't this a real pretty lady showin' up... Heh heh.
You will not lay a hand on these men!
Even so...
For the mental and physical pain my boys suffered,
we're gonna need some proper apology money...
Apology money! Apology money!
I have no money to give thugs like you!
Guess we'll just have 'em pay with their bodies, then...
Hey, fold these guys up!
You got it, boss!
Relax, we ain't gonna kill ya!
Just hold still a bit and it'll be over quick... Heh heh.
D-damn it... Do it, then!
Uh-oh! Scram!
Eeek! What the...
One, two, three... No way!
There's 100 of 'em! Damn it, you'll pay for this!
It seems I made it in time...
Wan-Fu can't even protect a single dojo, yet he goes looking for a true man? Laughable...
W-we have no excuse...
It is all due to our weakness.
Hmph... I do recognize your abilities.
What I blame is Wan-Fu,
whose small mind can only use men like you
as mere servants!
Truly, as his brother, I am ashamed!
Lord Wan-Long... that is not so.
Lord Wan-Fu's character may not surpass yours,
but it is by no means inferior.
I am grateful for your help, but...
you drove off those ruffians with the power of an army.
Wan-Fu would have his own way of doing things.
Hmph... Ming Ming, you are only a woman after all.
It is best to crush evil with even greater force...
It is quick and leaves no trouble... especially with scum like that.
...Lord Wan-Long.
...Never mind. You would never understand.
...If you had understood, by now... No...
We're leaving!
Because our training was lacking,
we have brought shame upon Lord Wan-Fu.
It's all right...
You protected the dojo.
You have nothing to be ashamed of.
...My lady.
(Dear... please come home soon.)
Damn it, just for a couple of thieves,
they bring out 100 soldiers?!
What kinda place is this Peking, anyway?!
If you ask me,
that guy's just a yellow-bellied chicken!
Hmph! Throwin' your weight around with numbers? Not cool!
Yeah, yeah!
Those cocky kung fu punks had more guts than him!
I ain't gonna rest till we pay 'em back!
...My pride's been totally wrecked!
Gahahaha! You're in quite a foul mood!
What the?! Who the hell are you?!
If you got no business here, go drink in a corner
for your own good!
Y-yeah! The boss may not look it, but...
he's s-s-s-sensitive!
Now, now...
Hey, you!
10 orders of pork buns for these fellows!
And more sake!
Well now...
If you don't mind me, I'd like to hear your story...
Hmph! Those guys from some dojo
picked a fight with my boys!
So we go to complain, and they bring soldiers!
Mmph... Soldiers at some dojo, eh...
I mean, come on,
they didn't show any peaceful attitude
about talkin' it out at all...
Of course, of course...
That town of Peking is nothing but a stew of barbarians!
Hey!
More dumplings too! 50 servings, and make it snappy!
Heh... You're easier to talk to than I thought...
I kinda like you.
Gahahaha!
To tell the truth, I like you too!
How about it, I've got a juicy tip just for you...
No, but still...
Wh-what? Don't leave me hangin'... Hey...
Hmm, I wouldn't want to cause you any trouble...
I-it's fine!
We're pals, you and me... right, right?
...Interested in the Peking Emperor's treasure?
Whoa, yeah, yeah! You bet!
We got a real weakness for treasure... Heh heh.
Yay! Treasure, treasure!
Well, you see...
there's hardly any treasure worth a thing left in Peking,
believe it or not!
Just between us, the last emperor
blew it all in grand style...
Whaaat?! For real?!
If you want to strike it rich, go west...
Ah yes, Paris was a big, wonderful city...
They say it's called the City of Flowers!
The City of Flowers... Paris, huh...
Paris, huh...
Has a nice ring to it, don't it?
All right, boys! So long to this lousy town!
Our goal is the City of Flowers, Paris!
Thanks for the tip! See ya, old man!
See ya!
Lord Wan-Fu... those people,
I think they're a notorious gang of crooks in Peking.
Gahahaha... So it seems!
I wish you'd taught them a lesson, Lord Wan-Fu...
